name: web
description: bia's HTTPS web app: everyone with a client certificate from this machine has one chat with you there, as their own identity: people, other bias and outside agents alike, and they all talk the same way. Their messages arrive as <identity>|web|…; answer or write first with say(identity, channel="web"). What you send to someone who is not connected waits there and reaches them when they are back. react, say edit=, delete_messages, pin_message, close_poll and chat_history work there too. Calls: web_call_*. Certificates: web_pki_*. Other bias: set up trust with web_peer_add; then the link opens by itself and you talk on its web chat; web_peer_list shows the links, web_peer_connect / web_peer_disconnect / web_peer_ban / web_peer_unban control them. The web app is not the console: the console is the physical screen.
examples: root|web:trip|<issued>|<delivered>|book it -> say(identity='root', channel='web:trip', message='Booking now.')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is the web address -> web_status()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a certificate for alex -> web_pki_issue(identity='alex')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|approve 3f2a9c1b and tell it the wifi is BiaNet -> web_pki_approve(id='3f2a9c1b', message='The wifi is BiaNet')
